reuse.why: Folds the six copied provider link functions into one linkProviderAccount and the Pluggy/Akahu downloaders into downloadProviderTransactions, but rewrites the unlink field-clearing instead of sharing it with unlinkAccount.

duplication.why: It removes most of the pre-existing per-provider copies; the one new copy is the db.updateAccount block that nulls the link fields, which repeats unlinkAccount.

placement.why: Link rules live in accounts/app.ts, downloads in accounts/sync.ts, the URL in server-config.ts and the account type in types/models, matching how the tree places each provider.

scope.why: The consolidation of the link and download functions goes beyond the literal requests, but it is what lets the four rules land once; no unrelated files are touched.

maintainability.why: One link path now enforces the duplicate, closed-account and replace rules for every provider, though linkProviderAccount carries several provider-specific options (institution override, newAccountFields, fileId).

bypasses_abstraction.where: All provider link handlers, including the new linkFintegraAccount, go through linkProviderAccount and findBankAccountHolder.

disguised_duplication.where: The link-clearing db.updateAccount block in linkProviderAccount is a plain copy of the one in unlinkAccount, not disguised.

abstraction_drift.where: linkProviderAccount takes provider-specific options (institution override and newAccountFields for GoCardless, fileId for Pluggy) plus replaceExistingLink, and has an institutionOverride ?? fallback branch; every provider handler calls it.
